evidence_excerpts.normalized_excerpt: The town is overjoyed at the death of the tree and gathers for a drunken revelry that stretches into the evening hours and gets the crew good and drunk. Caelynn abstains from the drink but not the festivities. At some point some asshole human named Steve makes some shitty remarks about non-humans. As the the hours of party stretch and folk are gathered around bonfires the ground begins to rumble anew. The shaking turns to bellows and screams as dozens on dozens of root like beatles crawl up from tunnels underneath the town. Townsfolk begin to fall, Steve the racist is shredded and knocked into a fire and a night of revelry turns to nightmare.

evidence_excerpts.normalized_excerpt: With little interest in being part of the rebuilding of Stone Bridge the heroes begin their ~5 day trek on foot to the West toward Mirathorn. After some time on this bucolic walk past fields, with an ominous forest to the south they encounter the hemp caravan led by Torvak Hempdealer. In between pitches of all the glorious ways hemp could improve the heroes lives Torvak also mentioned that his crew felt they had left the town of Hempholm just ahead of disaster, telling a story of a tree growing huge overnight and seeming to move. Without so much as considering buying any of Torvak’s incredible Hemp, the team marched on eager to investigate this bizarre tree.

evidence_excerpts.normalized_excerpt: The town of Stone Bridge is known for very few things, in fact Stone Bridge is hardly known. It has the Stone Bridge over the river [River name], it's tavern  The River's Edge Pub run by Grishna the Half-orc, and that's about it. It did have a job board, and most importantly the local brewer Glowkindle had posted a help request on the jobs board and spread word all around town of his need of a band of mercenaries to help clean up some rats.
